what_to_detect: A resolution exchanging the contents of two zones: zone_change events moving one player's cards from zone X to zone Y and from Y to X, or in one direction only where a zone was empty.
near_miss: A zone-exchange resolution that moves no card.
record_fields: acting line script text (Forge scripts a zone exchange as paired ChangeZoneAll clauses, as ExchangeZone, or through the Aura swap keyword, so no single api selects it)

what_to_detect: A card-for-card exchange between zones (an Aura swap) moves both cards when one player owns them both.
near_miss: The exchange moves no card because the cards have different owners.
record_fields: acting line keyword_display_name (an Aura swap line's script_api_type is Keyword, so api cannot select it)

what_to_detect: A zone exchange involving an attached card attaches the incoming card to the object the outgoing card was attached to: an attached event in the exchange's resolution.
near_miss: An exchange of an attached card that finds no card to exchange with, so nothing moves or attaches.
